@@ -0,0 +1,332 @@
+"""Safe image loading helper with SSRF protection.
+
+Supports:
+- ``data:image/...`` URLs (decoded locally without network access)
+- Relative storage keys and URLs matching ``settings.STORAGE_HOST``
+  (loaded directly through ``storage.download_image``)
+- External ``http://`` / ``https://`` URLs only when DNS resolves exclusively
+  to globally routable public IPs, pinning the validated IP on the socket
+  connection and re-validating every redirect target.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import ipaddress
+import socket
+import urllib.parse
+from typing import Optional
+
+import requests
+from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
+from urllib3.connection import HTTPConnection, HTTPSConnection
+from urllib3.connectionpool import HTTPConnectionPool, HTTPSConnectionPool
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.core.logging import get_logger
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 25 * 1024 * 1024  # 25 MiB
+MAX_REDIRECTS = 3
+
+_BLOCKED_HOSTNAMES = frozenset({
+    "localhost",
+    "localhost.localdomain",
+    "metadata",
+    "metadata.google.internal",
+})
+
+_BLOCKED_HOST_SUFFIXES = (
+    ".localhost",
+    ".local",
+    ".internal",
+    ".arpa",
+)
+
+_EXTRA_BLOCKED_V4_NETS = (
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("0.0.0.0/8"),
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("100.64.0.0/10"),  # CGNAT
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("192.0.0.0/24"),
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("198.18.0.0/15"),
+)
+
+_EXTRA_BLOCKED_V6_NETS = (
+    ipaddress.IPv6Network("64:ff9b::/96"),    # NAT64
+    ipaddress.IPv6Network("64:ff9b:1::/48"),  # NAT64 local-use
+)
+
+
+class UnsafeImageUrlError(ValueError):
+    """Raised when an image source is malformed or targets a disallowed address."""
+
+
+def is_public_ip(ip_str: str) -> bool:
+    """Return True only if ``ip_str`` is a globally routable public IP address."""
+    if not ip_str or "%" in ip_str:
+        return False
+    try:
+        ip = ipaddress.ip_address(ip_str)
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
+
+    if isinstance(ip, ipaddress.IPv6Address):
+        if ip.ipv4_mapped is not None:
+            return is_public_ip(str(ip.ipv4_mapped))
+        if ip.sixtofour is not None and not is_public_ip(str(ip.sixtofour)):
+            return False
+        if ip.teredo is not None:
+            return False
+        if any(ip in net for net in _EXTRA_BLOCKED_V6_NETS):
+            return False
+    else:
+        if any(ip in net for net in _EXTRA_BLOCKED_V4_NETS):
+            return False
+
+    return bool(
+        ip.is_global
+        and not ip.is_private
+        and not ip.is_loopback
+        and not ip.is_link_local
+        and not ip.is_multicast
+        and not ip.is_reserved
+        and not ip.is_unspecified
+    )
+
+
+def _is_safe_relative_storage_path(rel_path: str) -> bool:
+    """Validate that a storage object key is a clean relative path without traversal."""
+    if not rel_path or rel_path.startswith("/") or "\\" in rel_path:
+        return False
+    if "?" in rel_path or "#" in rel_path:
+        return False
+    if any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in rel_path):
+        return False
+    segments = rel_path.split("/")
+    return not any(seg in ("", ".", "..") for seg in segments)
+
+
+def _extract_storage_path(raw: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Return a validated storage object key if ``raw`` refers to our storage, else None."""
+    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(raw)
+
+    if not parsed.scheme and not parsed.netloc and not raw.startswith("//"):
+        first_segment = raw.split("/", 1)[0]
+        if ":" in first_segment:
+            raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Invalid image path")
+        unquoted = urllib.parse.unquote(raw)
+        if not _is_safe_relative_storage_path(unquoted):
+            raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Invalid relative storage path")
+        return unquoted
+
+    storage_host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").strip().rstrip("/")
+    if not storage_host:
+        return None
+
+    storage_parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(storage_host)
+    if (
+        storage_parsed.scheme.lower() not in ("http", "https")
+        or not storage_parsed.netloc
+        or storage_parsed.hostname in (None, "none")
+    ):
+        return None
+
+    if (
+        parsed.scheme.lower() == storage_parsed.scheme.lower()
+        and parsed.netloc.lower() == storage_parsed.netloc.lower()
+    ):
+        base_path = storage_parsed.path.rstrip("/")
+        prefix = f"{base_path}/" if base_path else "/"
+        if parsed.path.startswith(prefix) and not parsed.query and not parsed.fragment:
+            rel_path = urllib.parse.unquote(parsed.path[len(prefix):])
+            if not _is_safe_relative_storage_path(rel_path):
+                raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Invalid storage URL path")
+            return rel_path
+
+    return None
+
+
+def _decode_data_image_url(raw: str) -> bytes:
+    """Decode a ``data:image/...`` URL locally without making network requests."""
+    if "," not in raw:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Malformed data URL")
+    header, encoded = raw.split(",", 1)
+    meta = header[5:].lower()
+    parts = [p.strip() for p in meta.split(";")]
+    media_type = parts[0] if parts else ""
+    if not media_type.startswith("image/"):
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Only data:image URLs are allowed")
+    if "base64" in parts[1:]:
+        return base64.b64decode(encoded)
+    return urllib.parse.unquote_to_bytes(encoded)
+
+
+def _resolve_and_validate_external_url(url: str) -> str:
+    """Validate an external HTTP(S) URL and return its pinned public IP address."""
+    if any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in url) or "\\" in url:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Control characters or backslashes are not allowed in URL")
+
+    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
+    scheme = parsed.scheme.lower()
+    if scheme not in ("http", "https"):
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Disallowed URL scheme: {scheme or 'none'}")
+    if parsed.username is not None or parsed.password is not None:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Credentials in URL are not allowed")
+
+    hostname = parsed.hostname
+    if not hostname or "%" in hostname:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Missing or invalid URL hostname")
+
+    try:
+        port = parsed.port or (443 if scheme == "https" else 80)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Invalid URL port") from exc
+    if port < 1 or port > 65535:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Invalid URL port")
+
+    host_norm = hostname.rstrip(".").lower()
+    if (
+        not host_norm
+        or host_norm in _BLOCKED_HOSTNAMES
+        or host_norm.endswith(_BLOCKED_HOST_SUFFIXES)
+    ):
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Disallowed internal hostname: {hostname}")
+
+    try:
+        addrinfo = socket.getaddrinfo(host_norm, port, type=socket.SOCK_STREAM)
+    except OSError as exc:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Failed to resolve hostname: {hostname}") from exc
+
+    if not addrinfo:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Hostname resolved to no addresses: {hostname}")
+
+    resolved_ips: list[str] = []
+    for entry in addrinfo:
+        ip_str = entry[4][0]
+        if not is_public_ip(ip_str):
+            raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Disallowed non-public IP address for host {hostname}")
+        resolved_ips.append(ip_str)
+
+    return resolved_ips[0]
+
+
+class _PinnedIPAdapter(HTTPAdapter):
+    """HTTPAdapter that connects to a pre-validated IP to prevent DNS rebinding."""
+
+    def __init__(self, pinned_ip: str, **kwargs):
+        self._pinned_ip = pinned_ip
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+
+    def init_poolmanager(self, connections, maxsize, block=False, **pool_kwargs):
+        super().init_poolmanager(connections, maxsize, block=block, **pool_kwargs)
+        pinned_ip = self._pinned_ip
+
+        class _PinnedHTTPConnection(HTTPConnection):
+            def _new_conn(self):
+                self._dns_host = pinned_ip
+                return super()._new_conn()
+
+        class _PinnedHTTPSConnection(HTTPSConnection):
+            def _new_conn(self):
+                self._dns_host = pinned_ip
+                return super()._new_conn()
+
+        class _PinnedHTTPConnectionPool(HTTPConnectionPool):
+            ConnectionCls = _PinnedHTTPConnection
+
+        class _PinnedHTTPSConnectionPool(HTTPSConnectionPool):
+            ConnectionCls = _PinnedHTTPSConnection
+
+        self.poolmanager.pool_classes_by_scheme = {
+            "http": _PinnedHTTPConnectionPool,
+            "https": _PinnedHTTPSConnectionPool,
+        }
+
+
+def validate_image_source(source: Optional[str]) -> None:
+    """Validate that ``source`` is a safe data URL, storage path, or public HTTP(S) URL."""
+    if not source or not isinstance(source, str):
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Empty image source")
+    raw = source.strip()
+    if not raw:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Empty image source")
+    if raw.lower().startswith("data:"):
+        _decode_data_image_url(raw)
+        return
+    if _extract_storage_path(raw) is not None:
+        return
+    _resolve_and_validate_external_url(raw)
+
+
+def _fetch_external_image(url: str, timeout: int, max_bytes: int) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Fetch an external image with SSRF checks on initial URL and every redirect."""
+    current_url = url
+    for _ in range(MAX_REDIRECTS + 1):
+        pinned_ip = _resolve_and_validate_external_url(current_url)
+        session = requests.Session()
+        session.trust_env = False
+        adapter = _PinnedIPAdapter(pinned_ip)
+        session.mount("http://", adapter)
+        session.mount("https://", adapter)
+
+        try:
+            with session.get(
+                current_url,
+                timeout=timeout,
+                allow_redirects=False,
+                stream=True,
+            ) as resp:
+                if 300 <= resp.status_code < 400 and "Location" in resp.headers:
+                    location = resp.headers["Location"].strip()
+                    current_url = urllib.parse.urljoin(current_url, location)
+                    continue
+
+                if resp.status_code != 200:
+                    return None
+
+                chunks = []
+                total = 0
+                for chunk in resp.iter_content(chunk_size=65536):
+                    if not chunk:
+                        continue
+                    total += len(chunk)
+                    if total > max_bytes:
+                        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Remote image exceeds maximum allowed size")
+                    chunks.append(chunk)
+                return b"".join(chunks)
+        finally:
+            session.close()
+
+    raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Too many redirects while fetching image")
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(
+    source: Optional[str],
+    timeout: int = 30,
+    max_bytes: int = MAX_IMAGE_BYTES,
+    raise_on_unsafe: bool = False,
+) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Load image bytes from a data:image URL, storage path, or safe public HTTP(S) URL."""
+    if not source or not isinstance(source, str):
+        return None
+    raw = source.strip()
+    if not raw:
+        return None
+
+    try:
+        if raw.lower().startswith("data:"):
+            return _decode_data_image_url(raw)
+
+        storage_path = _extract_storage_path(raw)
+        if storage_path is not None:
+            return storage.download_image(storage_path)
+
+        return _fetch_external_image(raw, timeout=timeout, max_bytes=max_bytes)
+    except UnsafeImageUrlError as exc:
+        logger.warning("Blocked unsafe image source", error=str(exc))
+        if raise_on_unsafe:
+            raise
+        return None
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.warning("Failed to load image", error=str(exc))
+        return None

+@pytest.fixture()
+def internal_server():
+    """Starts an HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 and records every received request."""
+    hits = []
+
+    class _Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+        def do_GET(self):
+            hits.append(self.path)
+            self.send_response(200)
+            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
+            self.end_headers()
+            self.wfile.write(b"INTERNAL_SECRET_DATA")
+
+        def log_message(self, format, *args):
+            pass
+
+    server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), _Handler)
+    port = server.server_address[1]
+    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+    thread.start()
+    try:
+        yield port, hits
+    finally:
+        server.shutdown()
+        server.server_close()

+def _create_project_episode_cut(client, headers, style_reference_url=None):
+    proj_payload = {"title": "SSRF Test Project", "genre_ids": []}
+    if style_reference_url is not None:
+        proj_payload["style_reference_url"] = style_reference_url
+    pr = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json=proj_payload)
+    assert pr.status_code == 200, pr.text
+    project_id = pr.json()["id"]
+
+    er = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": project_id, "episode_order": 1},
+    )
+    assert er.status_code == 200, er.text
+    episode_id = er.json()["id"]
+
+    cr = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": 1, "script": "Opening scene"},
+    )
+    assert cr.status_code == 200, cr.text
+    cut_id = cr.json()["id"]
+    return project_id, episode_id, cut_id
+
+

+def test_export_zip_and_webtoon_never_request_internal_urls(client, internal_server, url_template):
+    port, hits = internal_server
+    headers = signup(client)
+    _, episode_id, cut_id = _create_project_episode_cut(client, headers)
+
+    bad_url = url_template.format(port=port)
+    r = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut_id}", headers=headers, json={"image_path": bad_url})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    zip_resp = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=headers)
+    assert zip_resp.status_code == 400
+    assert b"INTERNAL_SECRET_DATA" not in zip_resp.content
+
+    strip_resp = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=webtoon", headers=headers)
+    assert strip_resp.status_code == 400
+
+    assert hits == []

+def test_dns_rebinding_redirects_and_traversal_are_blocked(monkeypatch, internal_server):
+    port, hits = internal_server
+
+    # 1. Hostname whose DNS resolves to a private/loopback IP must be blocked
+    def fake_getaddrinfo_private(host, p, *args, **kwargs):
+        return [(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM, 6, "", ("10.20.30.40", p))]
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "getaddrinfo", fake_getaddrinfo_private)
+    assert load_image_bytes(f"http://rebind.example.com:{port}/secret") is None
+    assert hits == []
+
+    # 2. Redirect from a public IP to an internal IP must never hit the internal server
+    def fake_getaddrinfo_public(host, p, *args, **kwargs):
+        if host == "public.example.com":
+            return [(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM, 6, "", ("93.184.216.34", p))]
+        return [(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM, 6, "", ("127.0.0.1", p))]
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "getaddrinfo", fake_getaddrinfo_public)
+
+    class _FakeRedirectResponse:
+        status_code = 302
+        headers = {"Location": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/secret"}
+
+        def __enter__(self):
+            return self
+
+        def __exit__(self, *args):
+            return False
+
+    requested_urls = []
+
+    def fake_session_get(self, url, **kwargs):
+        requested_urls.append(url)
+        return _FakeRedirectResponse()
+
+    import requests
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "get", fake_session_get)
+    assert load_image_bytes("https://public.example.com/image.png") is None
+    assert requested_urls == ["https://public.example.com/image.png"]
+    assert hits == []
+
+    # 3. Non-image data: URL and path traversal against storage are blocked
+    assert load_image_bytes("data:text/html;base64,PHNjcmlwdD4=") is None
+    assert load_image_bytes("../secret") is None
+    assert load_image_bytes(f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/../../secret") is None
